know, you make me feel, from head to heel

hey I've changed a lot, or maybe not
still you make me feel, from head to heel

tracks.title: Cinema

lyrics.line: some people are watching me go
I don't know I guess I grow
wait for the same year again
to drift away, I just wanna say
I chose to be all alone
in the car and in my home
all the streets, it all repeats
I can't erase all the trace
but your presence here it's a cheer
you have a friend in me
if you call, to talk it all
you have my secrets to keep
I do as well, I'll never tell
how does it feel to know?
it all repeats, we always meet
how does it feel to know?
that there's a light that always glows

tracks.title: My Innocent Sea

lyrics.line: a heavy feeling I can't pretend
it's in the way you lit up the room
the way you made all the flowers bloom
I will drive where the sun will set
let's not talk, let's just forget
despite the things you said to me
a right of passage in my innocent sea
inside my heart where you spend my days
outside the snow just simply snows
there's a shadow where we used to dance
a fleeting moment, my only chance
it's just the way the world moves on
despite the fact, your light is never gone

tracks.title: Roots Apart

lyrics.line: I took a train that does the waltz,
to the city of lights, a promise call,
an empty seat, a place we'd meet
tell me wouldn't that be very sweet?
a million people, they don't mean much
your warmth I want, I want your touch
so unlikely, that our hands would meet
a game of fate that I'd like to cheat
as the seat is filled, soft words unwind,
no dirty hands, no ties that bind,
a pact we make, the stars align,
“In a few years, see you here at nine.”
if I could tell the story straight,
I'd keep it a secret, a loving way
lovers as trees, it's how we grow
I guess when you are young you think
there will be many people to love
the truth of the matter is it only happens
I know with time we tend to fade,
as the world spins round the sun again,
I'll find you somewhere among the stars,
that's where all the stories live.
